IVX FINAL INDEPENDENCE MIGRATION
REMOVE RORK 100% + CLOSE EVERY FAIL/PARTIAL/IN-PROGRESS ITEM

OWNER DIRECTIVE

This is the final infrastructure migration.

IVX must become completely operational without Rork.

The objective is NOT to delete Rork references blindly.

The objective is:

REPLACE
→ VERIFY
→ CUT OVER
→ REMOVE
→ REVERIFY

Production must remain available throughout the migration.

CURRENT VERIFIED GAPS

The latest audit shows:

SHA_PARITY = FAIL

Local / Rork-router commit:
dba9f1cb

GitHub / Render / production:
295dcc48

CI = FAIL

Playwright = PARTIAL

Soak test = IN_PROGRESS

Rork dependencies reported:

- Rork git router
- @rork-ai/toolkit SDK
- withRorkMicro
- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_* variables
- Rork-specific development/runtime integrations

The autonomous engineering commit has not reached GitHub production.

THIS MUST BE ELIMINATED.

==================================================
GLOBAL RULES
==================================================

Do not return another plan.

Execute the work.

Do not claim:
- 100%
- independent
- release ready
- 10/10
- certified

until every gate below passes.

Do not delete the current working Rork path until the independent replacement has been proven.

Do not request credentials unless a real direct request proves:

- missing credential
- HTTP 401
- HTTP 403 permission failure
- revoked credential
- expired credential
- insufficient scope

Assume owner credentials already exist and first verify runtime binding.

Do not expose secret values.

Do not fabricate:

- commits
- SHAs
- workflow runs
- deploy IDs
- API results
- test results
- timing results

==================================================
PHASE 1 — FREEZE CURRENT PRODUCTION BASELINE
==================================================

Before migration record:

GITHUB_HEAD=
RENDER_SHA=
HEALTH_SHA=
VERSION_SHA=
DEPLOYMENT_ID=
BOOT_TIME=
HEALTH_STATUS=

Verify current production remains healthy.

Create rollback reference:

PRE_RORK_REMOVAL_BASELINE=<current production SHA>

Do not change production until rollback is available.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — COMPLETE RORK DEPENDENCY GRAPH
==================================================

Search the entire repository and deployment configuration for:

rork
RORK
rork.com
rork-direct
Rork git router
@rork-ai
withRorkMicro
EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_
RORK_
.rork
Rork proxy
Rork toolkit
Rork API
Rork auth
Rork functions
Rork Git Data
Rork deployment
Rork SDK
Rork build plugins

For EVERY hit classify:

A. PRODUCTION_RUNTIME
B. BUILD_TIME
C. DEVELOPMENT_ONLY
D. HISTORICAL/DEAD_CODE

Return:

DEPENDENCY
LOCATION
CURRENT_PURPOSE
REPLACEMENT
MIGRATION_RISK
STATUS

Do not remove anything yet.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — REMOVE RORK GIT ROUTER DEPENDENCY
==================================================

THIS IS PRIORITY #1.

The current blocker is:

IVX local/Rork-router SHA != GitHub SHA

Replace the Rork git router with DIRECT GitHub integration.

Required direct operations:

- repository metadata
- default branch
- HEAD read
- branch creation
- file/tree read
- commit creation
- commit push
- PR creation
- PR status
- check status
- merge
- branch cleanup

Use GitHub directly.

No Rork intermediary.

Test the existing GitHub credential against direct GitHub endpoints.

Return only status, not secrets.

Required direct permission tests:

repo read
contents read
contents write
pull requests read
pull requests write
actions read
checks read
branch read
branch write

If any fail:

return exact HTTP status and required permission.

DO NOT continue using the Rork router as the primary path.

Temporary fallback is permitted ONLY until direct GitHub push is verified.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — PUSH dba9f1cb DIRECTLY
==================================================

Take the currently stranded autonomous engineering change:

dba9f1cb

Verify whether it is still appropriate relative to current main.

If stale:

- rebase/recreate safely from current GitHub main
- rerun relevant tests
- produce a new real SHA

Then:

1. Push directly to GitHub.
2. Verify SHA through GitHub.
3. Create PR.
4. Run required CI.
5. Merge normally.
6. Deploy from GitHub to Render.
7. Verify production.

Required result:

LOCAL_SHA
=
GITHUB_SHA
=
RENDER_SHA
=
HEALTH_SHA
=
VERSION_SHA

SHA_PARITY = TRUE

No Rork git router may participate in this chain.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — GITHUB ACTIONS FULL INDEPENDENCE
==================================================

Repair GitHub Actions.

Current state:
CI = FAIL
runs reported with 0 steps.

Determine exact cause.

Check:

- workflow YAML syntax
- workflow enabled state
- Actions repository settings
- repository permissions
- job permissions
- path filters
- branch filters
- concurrency
- runner availability
- GitHub status/infrastructure
- required secrets
- dependency install
- working directory
- monorepo configuration

Required workflows:

1. PR-QA

- TypeScript
- lint
- backend tests
- Expo tests
- integration tests
- Playwright
- security
- build

2. MAIN-DEPLOY

- full QA
- deploy Render
- wait live
- health
- version
- SHA parity

3. MOBILE-BUILD

- Android
- iOS

4. AUTONOMOUS-WORKER-QA

- task
- code
- test
- commit
- PR
- merge
- deploy
- verify

If GitHub itself has an active infrastructure outage:

record external evidence.

Continue all independent phases.

But final certification remains blocked until CI actually executes successfully.

Required:

CI_STATUS = PASS

not "configuration looks correct."

==================================================
PHASE 6 — REMOVE RORK SDK / TOOLKIT
==================================================

For each dependency involving:

@rork-ai/toolkit
withRorkMicro
Rork SDK
Rork APIs

Identify what functionality it provides.

Replace it with:

- native application code
- owner-controlled backend API
- direct provider integration
- standard open-source dependency
- direct GitHub/Render/Supabase integration

Do NOT perform a blind search-and-delete.

For every replacement:

1. implement replacement
2. add tests
3. run tests
4. activate replacement
5. verify production behavior
6. remove Rork implementation

Required final result:

ACTIVE_RORK_SDK_IMPORTS = 0

ACTIVE_RORK_TOOLKIT_CALLS = 0

==================================================
PHASE 7 — REMOVE EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_* VARIABLES
==================================================

Find every:

EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_*

Replace with IVX-owned configuration.

Examples:

EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_API_BASE_URL
→ EXPO_PUBLIC_IVX_API_BASE_URL

EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_AUTH_URL
→ EXPO_PUBLIC_IVX_AUTH_URL

EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_FUNCTIONS_URL
→ EXPO_PUBLIC_IVX_FUNCTIONS_URL

EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_APP_KEY
→ remove or replace with IVX application identifier

Never place private secrets under EXPO_PUBLIC_*.

Implement temporary migration logic:

IVX variable first
→ Rork fallback temporarily

After IVX variables are verified in production:

remove fallback.

Required:

ACTIVE_EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_VARIABLES = 0

==================================================
PHASE 8 — REMOVE RORK BUILD DEPENDENCIES
==================================================

Verify IVX can build from a completely independent environment.

Starting only with:

GitHub repository
+
documented environment variables

Perform clean clone.

Then:

install
→ TypeScript
→ lint
→ backend tests
→ Expo tests
→ E2E
→ build backend
→ build web
→ build Android

No Rork workspace.

No Rork sandbox.

No Rork build proxy.

No Rork SDK.

No Rork-specific filesystem.

Required:

INDEPENDENT_CLEAN_BUILD = PASS

==================================================
PHASE 9 — PLAYWRIGHT PARTIAL → PASS
==================================================

Current state:

Playwright = PARTIAL

This is unacceptable for final certification.

Find every Playwright test that did not execute.

Determine why:

- browser installation
- environment dependency
- CI configuration
- base URL
- authentication fixture
- timeout
- application startup
- port binding

Fix the root cause.

Run the complete browser test suite.

Required:

PLAYWRIGHT_TOTAL=
PLAYWRIGHT_PASS=
PLAYWRIGHT_FAIL=0
PLAYWRIGHT_SKIPPED=<only intentionally documented cases>

PLAYWRIGHT_STATUS = PASS

==================================================
PHASE 10 — SOAK TEST IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETE
==================================================

Current state:

SOAK = IN_PROGRESS

Complete the soak.

Minimum useful observation:

2 hours.

Preferred:

4 hours.

Persist monitoring if execution session cannot remain open.

Monitor:

- /health
- /version
- authentication
- public chat
- owner AI
- investors
- buyer discovery
- deal tracking
- database
- queue
- worker heartbeat
- provider
- memory
- CPU where available
- restart count
- 4xx
- 5xx
- timeout rate

Report:

SOAK_DURATION
REQUESTS
SUCCESS
FAILURES
4XX
5XX
TIMEOUTS
RESTARTS
P50
P95
P99
MAX_LATENCY
QUEUE_STALLS
PROVIDER_FAILURES
DATABASE_FAILURES

Do not claim hours passed if they did not.

Required:

SOAK_STATUS = PASS

==================================================
PHASE 11 — DIRECT RENDER DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Verify Render can deploy directly from owner GitHub.

Architecture must be:

GitHub
→ Render

NOT:

Rork
→ GitHub
→ Render

and NOT:

Rork
→ Render

Verify:

- repo
- branch
- auto deploy
- deploy hook if used
- build command
- start command
- environment group
- health path

Trigger one independent deployment.

Return:

GITHUB_SHA
RENDER_DEPLOYMENT_ID
RENDER_SHA
HEALTH_SHA
VERSION_SHA

Required parity TRUE.

==================================================
PHASE 12 — IVX AUTONOMOUS SENIOR DEVELOPER
INDEPENDENCE TEST
==================================================

Now test IVX itself WITHOUT Rork control-plane dependency.

Give IVX IA one real production-safe engineering task.

It must:

ANALYZE
→ inspect code
→ modify code
→ add/update test
→ execute tests
→ direct GitHub commit
→ create PR
→ CI
→ merge
→ direct Render deployment
→ verify production
→ return evidence

Prohibited:

- Rork git router
- Rork deployment API
- Rork toolkit
- Rork sandbox dependency
- proof-only code
- sentinel changes

Return:

TASK_ID
JOB_ID
FILES_CHANGED
TEST_RESULT
COMMIT_SHA
PR
CI_RUN
MERGE_SHA
DEPLOY_ID
PRODUCTION_SHA

Required:

==================================================
PHASE 13 — RORK NETWORK ZERO TEST
==================================================

Monitor application and deployment traffic.

Execute:

- login
- member registration
- public chat

- business query
- autonomous engineering task
- deployment
- mobile launch

Detect any request to:

rork.com

or any other Rork-controlled endpoint.

==================================================
